hooks.name: load-agentic-framework-context
hooks.description: Loads AgenticFramework.md and DevelopmentProcess.md as session context

hooks.name: block-direct-git
hooks.description: Blocks direct git commit/push and pushes to Rancher-owned remotes

hooks.name: enforce-blueprint-before-write
hooks.description: Blocks source edits until an active blueprint exists under docs/development/

hooks.name: gate-before-subagent
hooks.description: Enforces sequential gate progression before testing-agent/review-agent run

hooks.name: gate-before-commit-ask
hooks.description: Fails fast if Gates 1-3 aren't valid before a commit-approval question is shown

hooks.name: sign-plan-gate
hooks.description: Persists the approved plan to docs/development/ and signs Gate 1 via Touch ID

hooks.name: sign-commit-gate
hooks.description: Signs Gate 4 via Touch ID and automatically commits/pushes/opens a draft PR

hooks.name: sign-test-gate
hooks.description: Parses the testing-agent report and signs/revokes Gate 2

hooks.name: sign-review-gate
hooks.description: Parses the review-agent report and signs/revokes Gate 3
